chunks.text: I'll be singing, It's the Hard-Knock Life!

pieces.title: My Line
pieces.intro: This is the orphans' line. Miss Hannigan just woke them up, and it is still dark outside!
pieces.tip: Rub your eyes and say it like you are so, so sleepy. Then say Yes, Miss Hannigan, slow and grumpy.

chunks.text: Oh my goodness, oh my goodness.

pieces.title: My Song
pieces.intro: These are the words to the orphans' song. First we say them like a chant. You learn the tune when you watch the orphans sing.
pieces.tip: Sing it strong, like you are scrubbing the floor! Stomp your foot when you sing hard knock.

chunks.text: It's the hard-knock life for us! It's the hard-knock life for us!
